# Governance Update Checklist

Use this checklist when updating governance, oversight, or policy-linked docs.

## Before editing

- Confirm the source change is material, not just a citation refresh.
- Identify which repo files are affected by the change.
- Keep the update framework-agnostic unless the repo explicitly requires examples.

## Typical files to review

- `REPOSITORY-CONTEXT.md`
- `AGENTS.md`
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- `docs/governance/safety-assessment.md`
- `docs/governance/human-oversight-model.md`
- `docs/governance/incident-reporting.md`
- `.agents/memory/decisions.md`
- `.agents/memory/lessons.md`

## After editing

- Re-read the updated docs for consistency.
- Check that the wording is policy-like, not conversational.
- Keep examples minimal unless they add real operational value.
- Open a PR and wait for the relevant checks to go green before merging.
